name: chief-of-staff
description: An operating layer for Claude Code: one Chief of Staff session watches every other session, a Production VP and a Communication VP come standard, you choose your own COOs through a guided interview, and cheap worker sessions do the work. Built to run unattended in bypass permissions mode: it decides and does the work itself, and only legal and money decisions reach you, as ready-to-click packets.
